data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Specify integration test behavioral descriptor — 'apply()-level integration test: invoke apply() with an authorized leaf mutation that writes dso-id label → assert (a) NO DsoIdLabelWriteError raised, (b) resulting Mutation list from apply() contains exactly one entry with target=label + payload starts dso-id- + action=create (for outbound_create) or action=delete (for inbound_clean_label), (c) no other label-touching mutations in the list. Behavioral observable contract: authorized writes produce exactly the expected mutation; no implicit other writes.'
